visualReview.reviewedBy: Root and separate car/track reviewers inspected the actual PNGs
accepted: SC7 rear body and road contact are visible with no obvious detached component or floating tyre in this view.
Edge lines and flush corner aprons follow the road and provide clear bend boundaries.
The foreground 50 m board is readable, planted, shadowed, and beyond the full shoulder.
The world map shows the connected circuit, two-lap race, solo practice and available travel.
limits: The rear three-quarter world car image does not verify front bonnet vents, nose or brake detail; current studio pairs cover that construction.
The marker view does not show the complete far-side bend or every chevron direction.
Sparse angular vegetation, broad ground and the abrupt photographed mountain transition remain visible realism limits.
The separate focused pass does not replace the failed nine-step pointer review.
The original 180000 ms startup budget was exceeded in the full bundled review.
SwiftShader and explicit frame submissions do not establish continuous frame rate or target-hardware performance.
Brief native pedal input and assisted full-event runs are not a human handling-preference study.
Captures use the production renderer in the real paused map/photo modes; focused PNGs exclude the HTML HUD overlay.
